// A Riemannian metric evaluated at a point of a 2D parameter domain: the three
// unique components of a symmetric positive-definite 2x2 tensor. G12 = G21.
// Units: squared world units per squared parameter unit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_tensor)
type RiemannianMetric2D
    implements IValue
{
    G11: Number;
    G12: Number;
    G22: Number;
}
